title: Freelance Payments Platform
subtitle: A client payment portal — contracts, invoices, and Stripe checkout — running on JSON files in Git instead of a database or server
seo_title: Freelance Payments Platform | React + Stripe + Vercel
seo_description: A freelance payment portal built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Clients sign contracts, review invoices, and pay through Stripe — all on JSON files in Git, no database, no server.
thumb_alt: Freelance payments platform — branded client login, contract signing, invoice review, and Stripe checkout

flow.text: A payment portal that runs on no database at all.
A freelancer sends a client one login link. From there the client signs a contract, reviews an invoice, and pays, while the whole thing runs on JSON files in Git instead of a database or server.

flow.caption: After finalizing contract specifics with the client, the AI automation assembles it in our contract template. When it's ready they're emailed a login keyword they pair with their name to make their first payment.
flow.alt: Client login screen, pairing a name with an emailed keyword to enter the payment portal

flow.caption: They review the contract and securely sign it on the platform. A copy is emailed when it's complete, and they can download one for their records right away.
flow.alt: Contract review and signing screen with a downloadable copy of the signed agreement

flow.caption: Their invoice loads for review before they continue to pay.
flow.alt: Invoice review screen showing line items before continuing to payment

flow.caption: Payment completes through secure, well-known Stripe.
flow.alt: Stripe checkout completing the client payment securely

flow.text: That's it. When the project is done they get one more email if there's a balance to settle.

items: React, TypeScript, and Vite on the front end
Vercel serverless plus GitHub Actions handling the back-office work
Each job is a single JSON file in Git, giving version history, an audit trail, and zero database cost

flow.text: Built through AI-assisted development: paired with AI the whole way, with every architectural decision made deliberately, not vibe-coded.

achievements.headline: A client payment portal that runs on $0 of infrastructure.
achievements.details: Contract signing, invoicing, split Stripe payments, and document downloads, all from JSON files in Git. No database, no server.
